title: Final Energy Derivative
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly derive (partial E/partial x)_T as 0.

title: Final Heat Capacity Derivative
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly derive (partial c_x/partial x)_T as 0.

title: Final Heat Capacity
description: Essential Criteria - The student must state c_x(x, T) = K.

title: Final Internal Energy
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide E(x, T) = K(T - T_0) + E(T_0).

title: Final Entropy Expression
description: Essential Criteria - The student must present S(x, T) correctly as K ln T - A(x^2/(2l_0) + l_0^2/x) + const.

title: Final Temperature Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The student must derive the final temperature T_f = T_0 exp(0.292 A l_0 / K).

title: Incorrect Energy Derivative
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student incorrectly states (partial E/partial x)_T as anything other than 0.

title: Incorrect Heat Capacity Derivative
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student incorrectly states (partial c_x/partial x)_T as anything other than 0.

title: Missing Constants
description: Optional Criteria - The student should include any necessary constants in the final expressions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should ensure all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
